title.en: The best seller in each category

hints.tr: İki adım, iki ad. Birincisi ürün başına satılan adet: `WITH units AS (SELECT i.product_id, SUM(i.quantity) AS units ... GROUP BY i.product_id)`.
hints.en: Two steps, two names. The first is the units sold per product: `WITH units AS (SELECT i.product_id, SUM(i.quantity) AS units ... GROUP BY i.product_id)`.

hints.tr: İkincisi birinciyi kullanıyor: `ranked AS (SELECT ..., ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.category_code ORDER BY u.units DESC) AS rn FROM units u JOIN products p ...)`. İki CTE virgülle ayrılıyor; en sonda `WHERE rn = 1`.
hints.en: The second uses the first: `ranked AS (SELECT ..., ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.category_code ORDER BY u.units DESC) AS rn FROM units u JOIN products p ...)`. The two CTEs are separated by a comma; at the very end, `WHERE rn = 1`.

hints.tr:
Sorgunun tamamı:

```sql
WITH units AS (
    SELECT i.product_id, SUM(i.quantity) AS units
    FROM order_items i
    JOIN orders o ON o.id = i.order_id
    WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
    GROUP BY i.product_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT p.category_code, p.name, u.units,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.category_code
                              ORDER BY u.units DESC) AS rn
    FROM units u
    JOIN products p ON p.id = u.product_id
)
SELECT category_code, name, units
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY category_code;
```
hints.en:
The whole query:

```sql
WITH units AS (
    SELECT i.product_id, SUM(i.quantity) AS units
    FROM order_items i
    JOIN orders o ON o.id = i.order_id
    WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
    GROUP BY i.product_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT p.category_code, p.name, u.units,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.category_code
                              ORDER BY u.units DESC) AS rn
    FROM units u
    JOIN products p ON p.id = u.product_id
)
SELECT category_code, name, units
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY category_code;
```

hint.tr: Bu bölüm `WITH` çalıştırıyor: ara sonucu `WITH ad AS (...)` ile adlandır.
hint.en: This section practises `WITH`: name the intermediate result with `WITH name AS (...)`.
